original.question: So Sam e Harry heɓi 100 kafa caka hakkunde maji, te maji fotii ceerndu ɗum, Harry heɓa 60 kafa ɓuri Sam, ko foti heddoo Sam?
original.answer:
Ƴe x wonde limoore caka Sam heɓata te y wonde limoore Harry heɓata. Anndu wonde y = x + 60, te y + x = 100.
So a mbadii eekuasiyoŋ arande nder eekuasiyoŋ ɗiɗaɓo, en keɓi 2x+60=100
So a ɓaditii 60 nder ɗee ɗiɗi, en keɓi 2x=40
En ceerdu kala ɓaɗal e ɗiɗi, hokkude x=20. Ɗum firti Sam heɓi 20 kafa caka bannge.
#### 20
